accepted_claim.name: lossless equality-conditioned temporal quotienting
accepted_claim.statement: For a frozen H67 ep35 T=2 selected-window attention row core, two exact Q/K-derived descriptors with equal scores are represented by one class/shiftmax transaction while temporal identities and independently gated K reads remain reversible.
accepted_claim.scope: MSSB5 score front through quotient/FIFO/class directory/Shiftmax/synchronous K read/gated-K output

findings.finding: Both A/B runs use MEMORY_IMPL=0 and macro_count=0; K banks, FIFO, class histogram and descriptor stores are synthesized as flop/logic arrays.
findings.impact: The matched area ratio is useful as logic sensitivity, but absolute area and any SRAM energy claim are inadmissible.
findings.required_action: Use identical capacity, port and latency SRAM/RF macro contracts in both A/B runs and include peripheral/mux/unused-depth costs.

findings.finding: No Formality receipt exists for production RTL to either mapped netlist or for the DC-compatibility snapshot to production MSSB5.
findings.impact: Frozen VCS proves the exercised trace, not exhaustive equivalence.
findings.required_action: Run RTL-to-netlist Formality for both wrappers and an exhaustive equivalence check for the one-line generate compatibility rewrite.

findings.finding: No matched SAIF/PTPX run or energy per row/token exists.
findings.impact: The expected activity benefit from 45.09% fewer slots is not yet a measured energy result.
findings.required_action: Replay the same 138 rows with comparable SAIF mapping, run PTPX, and report dynamic, leakage, energy/row and EDP.

findings.finding: The exact MSSB5 cycle A/B is sample0/138 rows; the existing 10-sample/1380-row evidence uses the direct score front rather than the DC MSSB5 configuration.
findings.impact: Cross-sample generalization of the exact paper configuration is not closed.
findings.required_action: Rerun the 10-sample suite with MSSB5_SCORE_FRONT=1 and preserve per-sample distributions, not only the aggregate.

findings.finding: The measured core is only 0.5889% of the fixed activity-weighted network envelope and excludes Q/K/output projections.
findings.impact: 1.1865x is a component number; the admitted modeled network envelope is only 1.00091x.
findings.required_action: Keep this as an attention submodule contribution and combine it with separately admitted high-coverage modules in the final cycle simulator.

findings.finding: DC uses ideal clock and ZeroWireload; setup margin is only 0.0008ns in both designs.
findings.impact: The 3ns frequency is not post-route or extracted signoff and has effectively no DC setup margin.
findings.required_action: Run macro-aware physical synthesis/place-route and extracted PrimeTime setup/hold before claiming frequency.

findings.finding: Several SVA cover properties have zero hits because they are mode-specific or target an unused second shared workspace.
findings.impact: Assertions pass, but complete cover closure must not be claimed.
findings.required_action: Split mode-conditional coverage plans and add a concurrent-workspace test if the shared backend is retained.

findings.finding: Postcompile check_design reports 196/169 unconnected ports and 123/107 unloaded nets for Fixed/RQTB, largely monitors, constant high score bits and mode-specific fields.
findings.impact: This is not a timing failure, but obscures accidental dead logic and makes review noisy.
findings.required_action: Create paper wrappers that expose only consumed observability or document a lint waiver table by signal class.

findings.finding: The 87,034-cycle shared result also applies zero-output-row bypass and is not the RQTB-only A/B.
findings.impact: Attributing 112,589/87,034 to RQTB would mix mechanisms.
findings.required_action: If row bypass is adopted, synthesize and report it as a separate incremental ablation after RQTB.

findings.finding: The cycle test uses a deterministic LFSR backpressure schedule and one selected T450 window per attention block/head.
findings.impact: The A/B is fair, but throughput sensitivity to downstream readiness and window selection is not characterized.
findings.required_action: Add no-stall, stress-stall and all-window sensitivity while retaining the frozen fair schedule as the primary anchor.

algorithm_feedback: Expose exact per-pair temporal score equality as a training/evaluation KPI: sample0 achieves 28,001/31,050 = 90.18%, which directly determines the 45.09% slot reduction.

Explore accuracy-guarded Q/K quantization or a temporal-consistency regularizer that raises exact score equality without changing active outputs; report accuracy, equality fraction and predicted RQTB cycles together.
Keep zero-output-row probability as an independent KPI. The existing shared schedule suggests additional opportunity, but it must remain a separate ablation from quotienting.
